visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of several rows of glass jars filled with different varieties and colors of miso paste, arranged on wooden shelves against a backdrop of blue banners. (2) A black circular tray is placed on a wooden table, containing a wooden bowl of steaming miso soup, a pair of wooden chopsticks, and a triangle-shaped onigiri wrapped in clear plastic. (3) A sequence of quick cuts shows a white outdoor sign with a palm tree and skull logo, followed by a hand pointing to a printed menu list detailing various regional miso types. (4) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige trench coat and a white top, sits at a small wooden table, lifting the wooden bowl to her mouth to drink the soup. (5) Extreme close-ups reveal the contents of the soup, specifically green seaweed and small white tofu cubes being lifted by chopsticks, then a different, much darker broth in another wooden bowl. (6) The camera shows a wide shot of the interior of the 'MISO MEBORE' shop, featuring a counter with a display case and walls lined with the signature miso jars. (7) The final shot returns to the tray of soup and onigiri before transitioning to a pink and white ending screen with social media icons and the website 'japanuts.com'.
